title: Fort Harrow | Nat 20 Pixels C1E10
description:
The far end of the Lantern Road: a tired fort, forty soldiers, and a captain who needs help.
At the gate, someone says a name Brannoc has never said out loud.

Episode 10 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story, and the end of the first act. Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel bring their report to Captain Rook at Fort Harrow, get hired, try to haggle, and are shown something a patrol took off a dead goblin that evening. Every roll is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.
